operations.name: Add attributes to findings
operations.description: Assigns attributes (key and value pairs) to the findings that are specified by the ARNs of the findings.

operations.name: Create assessment target
operations.description: Creates a new assessment target using the ARN of the resource group that is generated by CreateResourceGroup. If resourceGroupArn is not specified, all EC2 instances in the current AWS account and region are included in the assessment target. If the service-linked role isn’t already registered, this action also creates and registers a service-linked role to grant Amazon Inspector access to AWS Ser

operations.name: Create assessment template
operations.description: Creates an assessment template for the assessment target that is specified by the ARN of the assessment target. If the service-linked role isn’t already registered, this action also creates and registers a service-linked role to grant Amazon Inspector access to AWS Services needed to perform security assessments.

operations.name: Create exclusions preview
operations.description: Starts the generation of an exclusions preview for the specified assessment template. The exclusions preview lists the potential exclusions (ExclusionPreview) that Inspector can detect before it runs the assessment.

operations.name: Create resource group
operations.description: Creates a resource group using the specified set of tags (key and value pairs) that are used to select the EC2 instances to be included in an Amazon Inspector assessment target. The created resource group is then used to create an Amazon Inspector assessment target. For more information, see CreateAssessmentTarget.

operations.name: Delete assessment run
operations.description: Deletes the assessment run that is specified by the ARN of the assessment run.

operations.name: Delete assessment target
operations.description: Deletes the assessment target that is specified by the ARN of the assessment target.

operations.name: Delete assessment template
operations.description: Deletes the assessment template that is specified by the ARN of the assessment template.

operations.name: Describe assessment runs
operations.description: Describes the assessment runs that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment runs.

operations.name: Describe assessment targets
operations.description: Describes the assessment targets that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment targets.

operations.name: Describe assessment templates
operations.description: Describes the assessment templates that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment templates.

operations.name: Describe cross account access role
operations.description: Describes the IAM role that enables Amazon Inspector to access your AWS account.

operations.name: Describe exclusions
operations.description: Describes the exclusions that are specified by the exclusions' ARNs.

operations.name: Describe findings
operations.description: Describes the findings that are specified by the ARNs of the findings.

operations.name: Describe resource groups
operations.description: Describes the resource groups that are specified by the ARNs of the resource groups.

operations.name: Describe rules packages
operations.description: Describes the rules packages that are specified by the ARNs of the rules packages.

operations.name: Get assessment report
operations.description: Produces an assessment report that includes detailed and comprehensive results of a specified assessment run.

operations.name: Get exclusions preview
operations.description: Retrieves the exclusions preview (a list of ExclusionPreview objects) specified by the preview token. You can obtain the preview token by running the CreateExclusionsPreview API.

operations.name: Get telemetry metadata
operations.description: Information about the data that is collected for the specified assessment run.

operations.name: List assessment run agents
operations.description: Lists the agents of the assessment runs that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment runs.

filter.description: Contains information about an Amazon Inspector agent. This data type is used as a request parameter in the ListAssessmentRunAgents action.

operations.name: List assessment runs
operations.description: Lists the assessment runs that correspond to the assessment templates that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment templates.

filter.description: Used as the request parameter in the ListAssessmentRuns action.

operations.name: List assessment targets
operations.description: Lists the ARNs of the assessment targets within this AWS account. For more information about assessment targets, see Amazon Inspector Assessment Targets.

filter.description: Used as the request parameter in the ListAssessmentTargets action.

operations.name: List assessment templates
operations.description: Lists the assessment templates that correspond to the assessment targets that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment targets.

filter.description: Used as the request parameter in the ListAssessmentTemplates action.

operations.name: List event subscriptions
operations.description: Lists all the event subscriptions for the assessment template that is specified by the ARN of the assessment template. For more information, see SubscribeToEvent and UnsubscribeFromEvent.

operations.name: List exclusions
operations.description: List exclusions that are generated by the assessment run.

operations.name: List findings
operations.description: Lists findings that are generated by the assessment runs that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment runs.

filter.description: This data type is used as a request parameter in the ListFindings action.

operations.name: List rules packages
operations.description: Lists all available Amazon Inspector rules packages.

operations.name: List tags for resource
operations.description: Lists all tags associated with an assessment template.

operations.name: Preview agents
operations.description: Previews the agents installed on the EC2 instances that are part of the specified assessment target.

operations.name: Register cross account access role
operations.description: Registers the IAM role that grants Amazon Inspector access to AWS Services needed to perform security assessments.

operations.name: Remove attributes from findings
operations.description: Removes entire attributes (key and value pairs) from the findings that are specified by the ARNs of the findings where an attribute with the specified key exists.

operations.name: Set tags for resource
operations.description: Sets tags (key and value pairs) to the assessment template that is specified by the ARN of the assessment template.

operations.name: Start assessment run
operations.description: Starts the assessment run specified by the ARN of the assessment template. For this API to function properly, you must not exceed the limit of running up to 500 concurrent agents per AWS account.

operations.name: Stop assessment run
operations.description: Stops the assessment run that is specified by the ARN of the assessment run.

operations.name: Subscribe to event
operations.description: Enables the process of sending Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) notifications about a specified event to a specified SNS topic.

operations.name: Unsubscribe from event
operations.description: Disables the process of sending Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) notifications about a specified event to a specified SNS topic.

operations.name: Update assessment target
operations.description: Updates the assessment target that is specified by the ARN of the assessment target. If resourceGroupArn is not specified, all EC2 instances in the current AWS account and region are included in the assessment target.
